# 什么是精选摘要（Featured Snippet）？

- 原标题：What Is Featured Snippet?
- 作者：Flavio Amiel Roborank 创始人
- 原文更新日期：2026-07-14
- 原文：https://roborank.io/glossary/featured-snippet/
- 栏目：[AI Search & GEO](https://roborank.io/ai-search/)
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。原文中的数据、观点、平台说明及推广内容均按原文保留，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

精选摘要是 Google 在搜索结果顶部方框中展示的答案，常被称为“第零位”。Google 从某一个已有排名的页面中逐字提取文字，将其排成段落、列表或表格，并链接回原始来源。它的目标是直接在搜索结果页回答用户的问题。

### 关键要点

- 精选摘要来自 Google 已经给予自然排名的**一个**页面，是对已有内容的提拔，而不是可以单独提交的另一种内容。
- 自 2020 年 1 月 22 日进行去重调整后，摘要来源页**不再在第一页重复出现**；摘要框算作该 URL 唯一的自然搜索位置，而不是额外的第十一个位置。
- 摘要主要有**段落、列表和表格**三种形式。Google 选择哪一种，取决于你的页面如何组织答案。
- [AI 概览](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/)如今经常出现在精选摘要上方，或直接取代它；它会综合多个页面生成答案，而不是只引用一个页面。

### 精选摘要如何运作

精选摘要不是你创建或提交的东西，而是 Google 将它已经在某个拥有自然排名的页面上找到的答案提拔出来。当查询看起来像一个问题时，Google 会扫描已经排在第一页的页面，找到最能回答问题的段落，将其基本按原文提取出来，放入常规搜索结果上方的方框中，并附上指向来源的链接。

由此产生两个前提。第一，页面必须已经针对该查询[排在](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-visibility/)第一页；Google 几乎只从排名靠前的结果中选取摘要，因此摘要是对已有可见度的提升，而不是绕过排名要求的捷径。第二，答案必须[易于提取](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/)：它需要是一个独立完整的段落，从页面中抽出并放进没有上下文的方框后，仍然读得通。这也是为什么[答案优先写作](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-first-writing/)——先明确给出答案，再展开解释——是赢得摘要框最可靠的单一做法。

Google 根据页面结构的相关信号选出具体段落：与查询匹配的标题正下方的一段简洁文字、使用正确标记的有序或无序列表，或者真正的 HTML 表格。清晰的结构让内容能够被提取。你不能付费购买精选摘要，也不存在可以申请精选摘要的标记；你能做的，就是让自己最好的答案易于抽取。

### 精选摘要的类型

Google 会用几种常见形式呈现精选摘要，具体形式由内容的组织方式决定：

- **段落式摘要**：最常见的类型。通常是一段约 40–60 个英文词的文字，直接回答“是什么”或“为什么”。Google 往往从与查询匹配的标题正下方提取这一段。
- **列表式摘要**：带项目符号或编号的列表，用于步骤（“如何……”）、排名或项目集合。Google 会依据页面实际的 `<ol>`／`<ul>` 标记或一系列标题构建它，因此真实的 HTML 列表标记很重要。
- **表格式摘要**：由行列组成的表格，常由价格档位、规格等对比或数据查询触发。Google 会根据你的 `<table>` 元素重建表格，因此真实的 HTML 表格比用文字拼出的假表格更容易稳定获得此类摘要。

还有一些细分变体，比如图片摘要、视频摘要，以及可展开的“其他用户还问了”答案。不过，在设计页面时，段落、列表和表格仍是最值得围绕的三种核心形式。

### 精选摘要示例

要理解精选摘要的价值，一个最清晰的真实案例来自其展示方式的一次调整。**2020 年 1 月 22 日**，Google 的 Danny Sullivan 宣布，出现在精选摘要中的页面，**不再在下方常规结果里出现第二次**。此前，一个摘要 URL 既能占据摘要框，*又*能占据普通蓝色链接位置，相当于同一页面在第一页占了两个位置。这也是旧称“第零位”的来源：第一页仿佛有十一个结果。去重之后，摘要只是该页面唯一的自然搜索位置。

人们自然担心，失去第二条展示会损失流量。SEO 平台 **seoClarity** 对此进行了直接测试。据 *Search Engine Journal* 报道，他们分析了约 **250,000 个**带精选摘要的关键词，并追踪了 2020 年 1 月 10 日至 23 日期间相关页面的实际自然流量，覆盖更新上线前后。他们发现，约 **28% 的摘要 URL 此前曾在第二位重复展示**，也就是说，超过四分之一的页面确实失去了一个位置。但 seoClarity 的 Mark Traphagen 根据多个行业的真实流量得出结论：这些页面在失去第一页的重复展示后，**“来自 Google 的自然流量没有出现具有统计显著性的差异”**。重复展示几乎没有带来额外贡献，真正发挥作用的是摘要框。

由此可见，精选摘要的价值从来不是多出的一条展示，而是占据页面顶部的答案位置。如今，这种理解比以往更加重要，因为 [AI 概览](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/)越来越多地出现在摘要上方或取代摘要，它会综合多个来源回答查询，而不是只引用一个来源。曾在 2020 年帮你赢得摘要框的那种清晰、独立完整的段落，正是如今 AI 概览最有可能抽取并引用的段落。

### 人们容易弄错的一点

精选摘要是传统搜索中最接近[可提取](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/)答案的形式，而它教会你的技能，恰恰就是如今赢得 AI 引用所需的技能。Google 会选择能用 40–60 个英文词干净利落地回答问题的段落：没有“如上文所述”，也不依赖页面其他内容。我曾见过排名第 4 的页面，仅仅因为答案独立完整，就击败排名第 1 的结果拿下精选摘要；排名第 1 的页面却把相同的事实埋在需要滚动三屏的位置。这不是某种摘要技巧，而是让你被 AI 概览引用的同一种做法。写出一段即便脱离全部上下文、被直接复制粘贴也能成立的文字，你就在同时优化这两种答案框。

### 精选摘要与 AI 概览的对比

|  | 精选摘要 | AI 概览 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **来源** | 从**一个**已有排名的页面逐字提取 | 综合**多个**页面和模型生成 |
| **构建方式** | Google 提取已有段落 | [AI 模型](https://roborank.io/glossary/google-ai-mode/)根据[有来源依据](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/)的材料生成文字 |
| **来源归属** | 一个链接，指向被引用的页面 | 多个带链接的引用 |
| **位置** | 位于自然搜索结果上方的方框 | 通常位于精选摘要**上方，或替代**精选摘要 |
| **获得方式** | [答案优先](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-first-writing/)、可提取的段落；第一页排名 | 围绕整个主题提升[可提取性](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/)与[引用就绪度](https://roborank.io/glossary/citation-readiness/) |

精选摘要引用单个页面；AI 概览则根据多个页面组织答案，并引用其中可信的来源。完整内容见[精选摘要与 AI 概览对比](https://roborank.io/ai-search/featured-snippet-vs-ai-overviews/)。两者越来越多地竞争同一个位置，而能赢得其中一种的写法，通常也有助于赢得另一种：让段落足够清晰，即使被抽离上下文也能独立成立。

### 常见问题

#### 什么是第零位？

第零位是精选摘要位置的昵称，也就是第一条常规自然搜索结果上方的答案框。自 Google 在 2020 年进行去重调整后，摘要页面被计作第一位，而不是独立的第零位，但这个说法仍然被广泛使用。

#### 怎样获得精选摘要？

你必须先在该查询的第一页获得排名，再把答案组织成 Google 能直接抽取的形式：用 40–60 个英文词明确回答问题，使用清晰的标题，并用正确的 HTML 格式呈现列表或步骤。精选摘要不能靠提交申请或付费获得。

#### 精选摘要以前会在页面上出现两次吗？

是的。在 2020 年 1 月 22 日之前，摘要 URL 可以同时出现在摘要框和常规结果列表里。Google 的去重更新移除了第二次展示，所以该页面如今只出现一次，即在摘要框里。

#### 精选摘要正在被 AI 概览取代吗？

越来越多的情况下，是的。在许多信息型查询中，AI 概览现在会出现在精选摘要上方，或直接替代它。精选摘要引用一个页面，AI 概览则综合多个页面。两者都在竞争搜索结果页顶部同一块注意力。

### 核心结论

精选摘要是 Google 将某个已有排名页面的答案提升到搜索结果顶部的方框中，并为其附上链接。获得精选摘要的过程，会教会你如何写出可提取、独立完整的答案，而这正是如今获得 AI 概览引用所需的同一种能力。随着 AI 答案不断超越精选摘要，占据更靠上的位置，摘要框作为最终目标的重要性正在降低，但它仍能证明你的内容具备被引用的条件。

## 英文原文

A featured snippet is the answer Google displays in a box at the top of its search results — often called “position zero.” Google lifts the text verbatim from a single ranking page, formats it as a paragraph, list, or table, and links back to the source. It aims to answer the query directly on the results page.

### Key Takeaways

- A featured snippet is extracted from **one** page Google already ranks organically — it is a promotion of existing content, not a separate thing you submit.
- Since a January 22, 2020 deduplication change, the snippet page is **no longer listed twice** on page one; the box counts as that URL’s single organic position rather than an extra eleventh slot.
- Snippets come in three main formats — **paragraph, list, and table** — and the format Google picks is driven by how your page structures the answer.
- [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/) now frequently appear above or in place of featured snippets, synthesizing an answer from multiple pages instead of quoting one.

### How Featured Snippets Work

A featured snippet is not something you create or submit — it is Google promoting an answer it already found on a page that ranks organically. When a query looks like a question, Google scans the pages it already ranks on the first page, finds the passage that best answers the question, extracts it more or less verbatim, and displays it in a box above the regular results with a link back to the source.

Two prerequisites follow from that. First, the page must already [rank](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-visibility/) on page one for the query; Google draws snippets almost exclusively from top results, so a snippet is a promotion of existing visibility, not a shortcut around it. Second, the answer has to be [extractable](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/) — a self-contained passage that reads correctly when lifted out of the page and dropped into a box with no surrounding context. This is why [answer-first writing](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-first-writing/), stating the answer plainly before you elaborate, is the single most reliable way to win the box.

Google picks the exact passage using signals about how your page is structured: a concise paragraph directly under a matching heading, a properly marked-up ordered or unordered list, or a genuine HTML table. Clean structure is what lets the extraction happen. You cannot pay for a snippet and there is no markup that requests one; you can only make your best answer easy to lift.

### Types of Featured Snippets

Google renders featured snippets in a few recurring formats, and the format is dictated by how your content is laid out:

- **Paragraph snippet** — the most common type. A block of roughly 40-60 words that answers a “what is” or “why” question directly. Google usually pulls it from a paragraph sitting immediately under a heading that matches the query.
- **List snippet** — a bulleted or numbered list, used for steps (“how to…”), rankings, or item collections. Google builds these from your page’s actual `<ol>`/`<ul>` markup or from a sequence of headings, so real list HTML matters.
- **Table snippet** — a grid of rows and columns, triggered by comparison and data queries like pricing tiers or specs. Google reconstructs the table from your `<table>` element, so a genuine HTML table earns these far more reliably than a table faked with text.

There are also refined variants — image snippets, video snippets, and expandable “People Also Ask” answers — but paragraph, list, and table are the three core formats worth designing your pages around.

### Example of a Featured Snippet

The clearest real-world lesson in what a featured snippet is worth came from a change to how they are displayed. On **January 22, 2020**, Google’s Danny Sullivan announced that a page appearing in the featured snippet would **no longer be listed a second time** in the regular results below. Before that, a snippet URL could occupy the box *and* a normal blue-link position, effectively giving one page two slots on page one — the source of the old “position zero” idea that there were eleven results on the first page. After deduplication, the snippet simply counts as that page’s single organic position.

The natural fear was that losing the second listing would cost traffic. The SEO platform **seoClarity** tested it directly. As reported by *Search Engine Journal*, they analyzed roughly **250,000 keywords** with featured snippets and tracked real organic traffic to pages over January 10-23, 2020, spanning the rollout. They found that about **28% of those snippet URLs had previously shown a duplicate listing** in the second position — so more than a quarter of pages genuinely lost a slot. Yet seoClarity’s Mark Traphagen concluded there was **“no statistically significant difference in organic Google traffic sent to these pages after they lost the duplicate listing on page one,”** based on real traffic across multiple industries. The double listing had been contributing almost nothing; the box was doing the work.

The takeaway is that a featured snippet’s value was never the extra listing — it was owning the answer at the top of the page. That reframing matters more than ever now, because [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/) increasingly appear above or in place of the snippet, answering the query by synthesizing several sources instead of quoting one. The same clean, self-contained passage that won you the 2020 snippet box is the passage an AI Overview is now most likely to lift and cite.

### The thing people get wrong

A featured snippet is the closest thing classic search ever had to an [extractable](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/) answer, and it teaches the exact skill that now wins AI citations. Google reaches for the paragraph that answers the question cleanly in 40-60 words, with no "as we discussed above" and no dependency on the surrounding page. I have watched a page ranked #4 win the snippet over the #1 result purely because its answer was self-contained and the #1 buried the same fact three scrolls down. That is not a snippet trick — it is the same move that gets you quoted in an AI Overview. Write the one paragraph that survives being copy-pasted with zero context, and you are optimizing for both boxes at once.

### Featured Snippet vs AI Overviews

|  | Featured Snippet | AI Overviews |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Source** | Extracted verbatim from **one** ranking page | Synthesized from **multiple** pages and models |
| **How it’s built** | Google lifts an existing passage | An [AI model](https://roborank.io/glossary/google-ai-mode/) generates prose from [grounded](https://roborank.io/glossary/grounding/) sources |
| **Attribution** | One link, to the quoted page | Several linked citations |
| **Position** | Box above organic results | Typically **above or replacing** the snippet |
| **You win it by** | [Answer-first](https://roborank.io/glossary/answer-first-writing/), extractable passages; page-one rank | [Extractability](https://roborank.io/glossary/extractability/) plus [citation readiness](https://roborank.io/glossary/citation-readiness/) across the topic |

A featured snippet quotes a single page; an AI Overview composes an answer from many and cites the ones it trusts — see the full [featured snippet vs AI Overviews comparison](https://roborank.io/ai-search/featured-snippet-vs-ai-overviews/). The two increasingly compete for the same slot, and the writing that wins one tends to win the other: a passage clean enough to be lifted without its surrounding context.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is position zero?

Position zero is the nickname for the featured snippet slot — the boxed answer above the first regular organic result. Since Google’s 2020 deduplication change the snippet page is counted as position one, not a separate zero, but the label persists in common usage.

#### How do you get a featured snippet?

You must already rank on page one for the query, then structure your answer so Google can lift it cleanly: state the answer directly in 40-60 words, use clear headings, and format lists or steps with proper HTML. You cannot submit or pay for a snippet.

#### Did featured snippets used to appear twice on the page?

Yes. Before January 22, 2020 a snippet URL could show in the box and again in the regular listings. Google’s deduplication update removed the second listing, so the page now appears only once, in the snippet box.

#### Are featured snippets being replaced by AI Overviews?

Increasingly, yes. On many informational queries an AI Overview now sits above or instead of a featured snippet. The snippet quotes one page; the AI Overview synthesizes several. Both compete for the same top-of-page attention.

### The Bottom Line

A featured snippet is Google promoting one ranking page’s answer into a box at the top of results and linking to it. Earning one is a lesson in writing extractable, self-contained answers — the same discipline that now earns citations inside AI Overviews. As AI answers push above and past the snippet, the box matters less as a destination and more as proof your content is quotable.
